verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own CLI tooling covers both halves of the story: `npm create cloudflare@latest my-app` scaffolds a project, and Wrangler's documented core commands handle creating, developing and deploying Workers. However, the evidence never shows one command that scaffolds and deploys together; deployment appears to be a separate Wrangler step, and no deploy command syntax is quoted. Missing for 10: evidence that a single command scaffolds and deploys end to end, documented deploy command details, and hands-on corroboration of the scaffold-to-deploy flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
A command line tool for building [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/).
